d: Awtad, a prominent real estate development company in Saudi Arabia, is in search of a dedicated and skilled Accountant to enhance our financial team. This role is crucial to maintain the integrity of financial operations and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. The successful candidate will be responsible for various accounting functions, supporting financial reporting and analysis to drive
q: At least two years of practical experience in accounting.
Practical experience in accounting, preferably in project accounting or within contracting and operations companies.
Good knowledge of supplier and contractor accounts.
Experience reviewing contracts, payment certificates, and invoices and matching them against payments.
Ability to reconcile account balances and perform accounting adjustments.
Knowledge of project cost monitoring, operating expenses, and petty cash management.
Knowledge of VAT and electronic invoicing requirements in Saudi Arabia.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting systems; experience with Odoo is preferred.
Strong analytical and accounting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
r: li
Manage and monitor suppliers' and contractors' accounts related to projects.
li
Review contracts, payment certificates, and invoices to ensure they comply with agreements, purchase orders, and payment terms.
li
Reconcile supplier and contractor balances and perform the necessary accounting adjustments.
li
Monitor project costs, operating expenses, and petty cash transactions.
li
Review due payments, amounts paid, and outstanding balances for each project.
li
Record project-related journal entries and ensure the accuracy of financial documents.
li
Follow up on invoices and payments and coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and relevant departments.
li
Prepare periodic financial reports covering project costs, expenses, and financial obligations.
li
Monitor Value Added Tax (VAT) and electronic invoicing requirements in accordance with the regulations applicable in Saudi Arabia.
li
Perform periodic accounting reconciliations and month-end and year-end closing activities.
li
Maintain and organize financial records and supporting documents related to projects.
li
Coordinate with Finance and Operations departments to ensure data accuracy and compliance with accounting procedures.

d: Job name: Software and QA Developer
We are looking for a motivated Software & QA Developer to join our team and help build, enhance, and maintain the bank’s core digital platforms.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career developer with strong programming fundamentals, a passion for quality, and hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools.
q: Up to 2 years of hands-on software development experience .
Demonstrable experience building projects using AI development tools such as Claude Code (preferred), Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar .
Good knowledge of Java 21 and Spring Boot .
Working knowledge of React and TypeScript .
Understanding of REST APIs, SQL (PostgreSQL), Git, and OAuth2/JWT.
Familiarity with API testing, automation testing, and software quality practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Good written English. Arabic language skills are an advantage.
Exposure to banking, financial services, or fintech projects.
Knowledge of Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
If you are passionate about software development, AI-assisted coding, and delivering high-quality applications, we would love to hear from you!
